Graph neural network for perturbation prediction 1
quote: The graph neural network module consists of a linear embedding-projection layer (4,096 to 128 dimensions) mapping frozen OCellus gene embeddings to the working dimension, an indicator-projection layer encoding knockout and baseline gene indicators, three graphconvolution layers with hidden dimension 128, LayerNorm, rectified-linear activation, and dropout 0.1, followed by a multi-layer-perceptron head producing continuous log2 fold-change predictions; total parameter count is approximately 583,000.
